_comment: latest: the newest Graveyard Keeper 2 version out there (scripts/build.py embeds it as meta.gameVersion). wiki: the game version the wiki recipes describe (embedded as meta.data.wiki; the footer shows it). When latest is newer than wiki, the footer says the data may be out of date (src/js/ui/footer.js).

note.pt: O jogo recebeu a versão 1.011, que muda algumas receitas (Frascos de Alquimia II, Suco de Uva); as receitas daqui ainda são da 1.010 e serão atualizadas quando a wiki for.
note.en: The game is now on version 1.011, which changes a few recipes (Alchemy Flasks II, Grape Juice); recipes here are still from 1.010 and will be updated once the wiki is.
